newsitem.title: USA: Health Fitness Physical changes name.
newsitem.headline: Health Fitness Physical changes name.

text.p: Health Fitness Physical Therapy Inc said Monday it has resumed the use of its former name, Health Fitness Corp.
Shareholders at the company's annual meeting June 4 will vote on a proposal to formalize the name change.
The company adopted the longer name in 1994 to reflect both of its lines of business -- preventive healthcare and rehabilitative healthcare.
Health Fitness common stock will continue to trade under the symbol HFPT.
The company manages 111 corporate and hospital-based fitness centers.
Shares of Health Fitness were trading unchanged at 2-1/2.
